title: Transfer project
exportHelp: Download a zip with the shots and only the GLB, audio and images they use. Shared files are stored once.
importHelp: Import a portable package into this workspace. A scenario template is not a full package. Failed imports leave the current project untouched.
repairNeeded: Replace missing or tampered files from the library, then import.
blocked: This file cannot be imported as a portable project.
templateRejected: This is a scenario template, not a portable project package.
cinemaRejected: Unknown cinema extension. Open it with the cinema viewer, not the generic editor.
externalRejected: Unauthorized external or transient media link.
traversalRejected: Rejected a path that leaves the package.
tooLarge: Package zip exceeds the size limit.
